text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …Y-yeah, it's just a little headache. It's not so bad that I can't handle it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's times like this when you have to dance the pain away! No way will I lose to a little head—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No, I won't give up! I'll just dance to the beat of my head throbbing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl struggles to shake off her headache for some time.
